# ruststream-sqlx

> `ruststream-sqlx` brings SQL databases into RustStream, a Rust framework for services that subscribe to message brokers and publish to them, through `sqlx`: a transactional outbox over any RustStream broker, and task queues in Postgres, MySQL/MariaDB and SQLite tables.

This site holds the entry pages. The crate is documented item by item on docs.rs, and the framework itself on the RustStream site.

## Site

- [Home](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-sqlx/latest/): the two components and where the rest of the documentation is

## Guides

- [The inbox broker](https://docs.rs/ruststream-sqlx/latest/ruststream_sqlx/index.html#the-inbox-broker): task queues in the service's Postgres tables, what each handler outcome does to a row, where "now" comes from, and what stops a service at startup
- [Testing a service on the inbox](https://docs.rs/ruststream-sqlx/latest/ruststream_sqlx/index.html#testing-a-service-on-the-inbox): `TestApp::start_live` against a real database and the real clock

## Optional

- [API reference](https://docs.rs/ruststream-sqlx): the full rustdoc of the crate
